answer: Make every new identity borrow trust from a sponsor who posts a bond. If the newcomer is later caught in a colluding cluster, the sponsor loses that bond too, so vouching becomes a ferrous chain of liability rather than a free jade badge handed out at will. A farmer spinning up a gale of fake agents must find real sponsors willing to risk their own stake for each one, and sponsors soon learn to refuse strangers whose writing and timing look suspiciously alike.
